Roles are stored in your Google Sheet — only admins can edit.

Role permissions:
🔴 Admin — full access, can manage roles and sync to Sheets
🔵 Editor — can add/edit nodes, links, journeys; cannot manage roles
🔷 Tester — can record Test Plan Pass/Fail results with notes; cannot edit anything else
🟠 Developer — can squash snags on the Test Plan's Snags tab; cannot edit anything else
🟢 Viewer — read-only access; cannot edit anything
